items.title: Rob Mounsey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 9, 2025
items.q: What it mostly meant was he’d play it for me and sometimes he would actually dictate certain parts to me and other times he’d just say just fill this in with something good.

ctx.x: So I’m trying to imagine how that works. Do you sit and listen to the track and you both trade turns like humming something — or here’s a spot let’s put something in here?
What it mostly meant was he’d play it for me and sometimes he would actually dictate certain parts to me and other times he’d just say just fill this in with something good. You
know. For instance in the song “IGY” I think that’s the opening song [scats] in B. If I turn this up –
